title: NvMAdminCaller
text: Call AUTOSAR NVRAM Manager (NvM) service interface NvMadmin; {Client port name} sets the name of client port AUTOSAR component uses to call NvM service interface, {Operation} and {Sample time} sets the block sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Client port name
params.values: Name of client port AUTOSAR component uses to call NvM service interface NvMAdmin NvMAdmin (default) | character vector

params.name: Operation
params.values: Operation defined in NvM service interface NvMAdmin SetBlockProtection (default)
